candidates.title: Prakash Reddy Demands Priyank Kharge’s Resignation over EC Remark
candidates.excerpt: Reddy accused Congress leaders of deliberately issuing statements aimed at discrediting constitutional institutions

candidates.title: Elon Musk posts ‘Dear Prime Minister Ambani,’ alleges monopoly over Starlink’s India entry
candidates.excerpt: SpaceX and Tesla CEO Elon Musk on Friday took another swipe at billionaire Mukesh Ambani over Starlink's entry into India, calling him "Dear Prime Minister Ambani,” and accusing him of seeking to maintain a monopoly and questioning whether he would allow the satellite internet service to compete in the country.

candidates.title: 36 people hurt after shopping mall ceiling collapses in South Korea’s Daegu city
candidates.excerpt: About 70 people evacuated the facility after the collapse, with President Lee Jae Myung instructing officials to ensure a thorough response

candidates.title: 7.2-magnitude earthquake strikes Panama
candidates.excerpt: A 7.2-magnitude earthquake struck Panama, with its epicentre 39 kilometres northwest of Tonosi, a town in Los Santos province, according to a revised report from the University of Panama's Institute of Geosciences.

candidates.title: Delhi: Security tightened outside CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s residence ahead of CJP protest
candidates.excerpt: Security has been significantly tightened outside Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s Delhi residence ahead of a planned Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest scheduled for Saturday.

candidates.title: Delhi on high alert ahead of Jantar Mantar protest; Metro stations closed, borders sealed
candidates.excerpt: Delhi Police remained on high alert on Saturday ahead of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) protest at Jantar Mantar, with security tightened across the national Capital, vehicles being checked at borders and police personnel wearing body cameras to record any untoward incidents.

candidates.title: Actor Imran Khan taken into custody ahead of CJP-linked protest in Mumbai
candidates.excerpt: Actor Imran Khan was detained by Mumbai Police at August Kranti Maidan ahead of a proposed protest supporting the CJP-linked demonstration in Delhi. His girlfriend Lekha Washington and others were also taken into custody as police enforced tight security measures and prevented the protest from proceeding.

candidates.title: Employees’ Union-led alliance takes early lead in TGSRTC recognised union elections
candidates.excerpt: The Employees' Union-led alliance has emerged ahead in the Telangana State Road Transport Corporation recognised union elections, according to preliminary trends, with a strong showing in the Greater Hyderabad region. The polls, held after nearly a decade, witnessed a 98 per cent voter turnout.
